startScreen.title: Signal Relay
startScreen.subtitle: The facility has gone dark. Restore power at three relay consoles, avoid the security drones, and get out before they catch you.
startScreen.howToPlay: WASD move, mouse look, F interact, Q fire, R reload, C crouch, Shift sprint. Consoles are quiet to power up but drones patrol the halls -- avoid their sight and hearing, or fight your way through.
startScreen.credits: Built in the Digital Opus Engine editor. Relay Console model, hazard panel texture, and pickup chime are original assets created for this game.

objectiveDefs.title: Restore power at all three relay consoles
Reach extraction
objectiveDefs.description: The security gate is open. Get out.

meta.title: Signal Relay
meta.description: A sci-fi facility exploration/escape game -- restore power at three relay consoles while avoiding roaming security drones, then fight or flee to extraction.
